title: mixed units in one expression
question: Does an arithmetic expression here combine two different units — ticks with turns, milliseconds with seconds, a 0-1 fraction with a 0-100 percentage, a per-tick rate with a per-turn total — without a conversion?
fail_requires: the unit of each operand and where each came from
the magnitude of the resulting error
not_a_finding: a conversion that is present but written without a named constant
a dimensionless multiplier applied to a quantity
two values that share a unit despite differing names

title: unit absent from the name of a numeric parameter or return
question: Does this symbol take or return a bare number carrying a unit that its name does not state, where a caller could plausibly pass the wrong one?
fail_requires: its actual unit, and how you determined it
a caller that could pass the other unit without a type error
not_a_finding: a count of things, which has no unit
a name that already carries the unit by an established project convention (workAmount, ageTier, toolTier)
a private helper with a single call site in the same file
